The reported return on invested capital (ROIC) for A.P. Moller - Maersk in 2024 was 12.3%, which was above the yearly target of above 7.5%.

This is based on the following points:
1.  The ROIC for 2024 was 12.3% [1].
2.  The yearly target for ROIC under normalised conditions was above 7.5% [1].
3.  ROIC is calculated as Profit/loss before financial items for the year (EBIT) less tax on EBIT divided by the average invested capital, last twelve months [3].

ArcelorMittal reported a group-wide Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR) of 0.70 for 2024.

This is based on:
1.  LTIFR is defined as Lost Time Injuries ("LTI") per 1,000,000 worked hours (own personnel and contractors) [3].
2.  A Lost Time Injury (LTI) is an incident that causes an injury that prevents the person from returning to his/her next scheduled shift or work period [3].
3.  The LTIFR for the TOTAL company was 0.70 in 2024 [4].

Lerøy’s wild-catch volume fell substantially in 2024, decreasing from 75,893 HOG in 2023 to 64,991 HOG in 2024. This represents a decrease of 10,902 HOG. The company expects 2025 and probably also 2026 to be challenging for the WildCatch segment due to the low quota basis.

Here's how we know:
1. The catch volume in 2023 was 75,893 HOG [1].
2. The catch volume in 2024 was 64,991 HOG [1].
3. The difference between the two volumes is 75,893 - 64,991 = 10,902 HOG [1].
4. The report states that earnings in the WildCatch segment have been significantly affected by low quotas and will remain so for some time, expecting 2025 and 2026 to be challenging [3].
